dinov2_table10_ade20k_linear.source: Oquab et al. 2023, Table 10, ADE20K mIoU, frozen features, linear (lin.)

siglip2_table2_ade20k.source: Tschannen et al. 2025, arXiv 2502.14786, Table 2, ADE20K mIoU, frozen

mae.source: He et al. 2021, arXiv 2111.06377: Table 12 linear probe ViT-B 68.0, ViT-L 75.8, ViT-H 76.6; Table 3 fine-tune ViT-B 83.6; ViT-H 87.8 at 448

datasets.LAION-5B: 5.85B pairs; CLIP ViT-B/32 cosine >= 0.28 English, >= 0.26 other; removed ~90% of 50B (Schuhmann et al. 2022, 2210.08402, sec. 3.1)
datasets.DataComp: CommonPool 12.8B; best filter +6.9 pp at 12.8B; DataComp-1B (image-based intersect CLIP score L/14 30%, 1.4B) ViT-L/14 79.2%, +3.7 pp over OpenAI CLIP L/14 (2304.14108)
datasets.MetaCLIP: 500k entries, cap 20k; ViT-B/32 fixed steps: raw English 57.4, no balance 60.8, MetaCLIP 65.5, WIT 63.4, LAION-400M 60.0 (2309.16671 Fig. 1)
datasets.DeiT: 86M, 83.1% ImageNet-only, under 3 days on one computer (2012.12877)
